title: Tomorrow's Heading
summary: Nell has a course for the rumoured wreck-waters of the Sapphire Sea.
description: The prologue's chores are done and the day is winding down. Nell reckons the Revenge raises the rumoured wreck-waters by morning. Finish whatever you like aboard, then turn in for the night.

objectives.text: Turn in for the night (your bed, Captain's Quarters)

title: Strange Cargo
summary: Something is floating off the starboard bow, and it is shouting.
description: One-Eyed Ned has sighted an object in the water off the starboard bow. It appears to be a bathtub. It appears to be complaining.

objectives.text: Investigate the object off starboard (telescope, starboard rail)
Bring the stranger aboard
Question the stranger
Decide what to do with Garrick

title: The New Recruit
summary: Garrick Guzzlegut's first day as a pirate. Keep an eye on him.
description: Mister Hale has put the new man to work swabbing the foredeck with Sully. Somebody ought to check that he is actually doing it.

objectives.text: Check on Garrick's assigned work (the foredeck)
See how the new recruit is scrubbing
Find Garrick in the galley
Speak with Salty Jim
Continue the afternoon duties (the mainmast)
Respond to the strange stomach noises

title: Treasure Inspection
summary: Last night's swell may have shifted the treasure. It needs checking, and a strong back.
description: The treasure room took a knock in last night's swell. Everyone else is busy, so Garrick has been volunteered to help move chests. What could go wrong?

objectives.text: Meet Garrick at the treasure room door (Cargo Hold)
Inspect the treasure
Move the fallen chest with Garrick
Survive the incident

title: Yellow Alert
summary: A yellow cloud is spreading through the ship.
description: Something in the treasure room has gone off. Something called Garrick. Get the crew topside and find out how bad it is.

objectives.text: Get topside (Main Deck)
Hear Garrick out about the cloud
Respond to Squawks' fall

title: Save Squawks
summary: Captain Squawks has fallen into the Dead Center.
description: A gust blew Squawks down the main hatch, straight into the thickest of the fumes. Rope up, mask up and go and get him. Don't linger in the thick of it.

objectives.text: Get a rescue line from Rook
Get a wet cloth from Doc Fennimore
Go below into the fumes (main hatch)
Find Squawks (follow his cries)
Get Squawks out to the stairs

title: The Price of Gold
description: Squawks will live. The question now is what the Gust did to twelve years of plunder.

objectives.text: Inspect the ruined treasure
Find out what the treasure is worth (Penhallow, Crew Quarters)
Ask Garrick whether the smell will fade
Deal with the crew (Main Deck)

title: The Yellow Defense
summary: Garrick's trial, interrupted by the Royal Navy.
description: The crew assembled to try Garrick Guzzlegut. Then a navy frigate arrived, and Garrick had an idea.

objectives.text: Respond to the royal frigate
Take the helm and bring her upwind
Release the contaminated sail (foremast line)
Watch the frigate retreat
Complete Garrick's trial
